desc_src: Henrique José Teixeira Matos (Porto, 18 June 1961) is a Portuguese painter particularly known for his Op Art paintings. He was born in Porto, Portugal, where he is currently living.

source_title: Alexander Pushkin automaton android by François Junod
desc_src: Completed in 2010 by François Junod and his team, the automaton of Alexander Pushkin is capable of writing 1,458 different poems randomly accompanied by a matching drawing. The first mechanical android in history to do that.

Danny Danon, Israel's Ambassador to the UN, lit the one of the candles on the world’s largest Hanukkah menorah in New York City on December 29, 2016, the sixth night of the eight-day holiday. The 36 foot, 4,000 pound menorah organized by Chabad-Lubavitch, was certified by Guinness World Records as the largest in the world. The nightly Hanukkah celebration has taken place at Fifth Avenue and Fifty-Ninth Street since 1977. The annual event is part of a worldwide Hanukkah campaign to raise awareness and observance of the Jewish festival, set into motion by the Lubavitcher Rebbe, Rabbi Menachem M.…
